profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer
profile.summary: Full stack software developer with several years of experience in development and architecture using Software Development Methodologies.

positions.title: C# Application Developer
positions.locationName: Camden County, New Jersey, United States
positions.description:
•	Developed an N-Tier Application and designed the Data Access Layer and Business Logic Layer using C#, MVC and ADO.NET.
•	Involved in developing and Migrating AngularJS and MVC applications (CSHTML) in Web role to Purely HTML application in Worker role and Web jobs of trigger based jobs.
•	Implemented single page applications (SPA) using NodeJS and TypeScript to support enterprise login system.
•	Involved in developing Complex queries, views and Store Procedures using T-SQL in relational databases such as Microsoft SQL server.
•	Experience in developing code in C# to read and write Service bus Queues and topics asynchronously.
•	Expertise with Version Control Systems like TFS, Microsoft DevOps and GIT.
•	Expertise in Azure Infrastructure Management (Azure web role, Worker role, SQL Azure, Azure Storage).
•	Continuously built and deployed Web Apps on Azure cloud account by configuring Cloud Platforms like Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Service Bus and Cloud Services.
•	Designed and developed web service using WCF and Web API (MVC) to receive and process XML/JSON files and deployed on cloud Service on Microsoft Azure.

positions.title: Sr. Application Engineer
positions.description:
Medidata

•	Developed a Windows Service to process large dataset using .NET framework 4.5 with C# as a programming language.
•	Integrated Business Object .NET SDK into windows service to create different object into business object environment.
•	Created test project into Visual Studio 2013 to perform Unit Test using Microsoft Fakes framework
•	Setup Continuous Integration (CI), build, and Deployment of the developed service using Jenkins tool with MSBuild and GitHub repository.
•	Used Git and GitHub repository tool for storing and securing source code versions effectively in a large development team.
•	Developed PowerShell scripts to install different components of the project like, Windows Service and Java SDK on the application server. Also, created a script to create/update Environment Variables for Java framework and Windows service.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Accenture

•	Prepare a Technical Design Document for the project of “Digitize CTA and Online Data tool”.
•	Integrate Excel with Web Based tool developed in .NET MVC. 
•	Develop VBA macros in excel document in order to download required data from Database in the excel document via Restful web service calls, and populate it in a tabular format. 
•	Work with JSON data parsing during data download and populating on the excel document.
•	Develop controller classes in the web service using .NET framework 4.5 and C# to handle data download and other condition checking. 
•	Implement Web UI for online tool with C#, Razor, CSS, JQuery and MVC Framework. 
•	Also, perform domain level builds using TFS 2013 build agent to deploy code in different environments like Integration, Testing, and Production. 
•	Coordinate with Off-shore team to divide work load, and schedule weekly meeting in order to track the work in progress.

positions.title: Application Architect/Software Developer
positions.description:
Firestone Building Products

•	Executed SDLC process for many applications in Firestone IT Infrastucture. 
•	Coordinated with vendors to gether requirements for setting up deployment environments
•	Managed and automated application deployments using Build Master tool.
•	Prepared and maintained a deployment plan to deliver Windows application into production using SCCM.
•	Developed and managed web applications using ASP .NET 4.5, MVC 5.0 and Entityframework. 
•	Developed and managed WCF Restful web services using Entityframework for error logging into database. 
•	Managed TFS for code repository and version control of project builds. 
•	Provided support to customize Documentum tool from EMC developed in JAVA.
•	Worked closely with DBAs to setup and maintain various SQL Server databases.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
DWA health care organization

- Developing and managing a Web Application using ASP.NET MVC v4.0 in Visual Studio 2012 with C# as a programming language to create and manage meeting events for different partner organizations of DWA. 
- Use an Entity Framework to create a Data Access Layer (DAL) for this project to load and save data from/to SQL Server 2008 database. 
- Used LAMBDA Expression to develop CRUD operations with Entity Framework using Linq to Entities. 
- Built JSON RESTful and XML/SOAP Web Services using the Web API, WCF and ASMX.
- Used Ajax methods to make an asynchronous calls to server side code to make website's performance better. Also used DataTable.Net JQuery PlugIn to develop interactive tables. 
- On ICUL project, I worked on Excel spreadsheet to develop their Financial Report. Developed code using VBA to restrict user actions and perform admin functions in the spreadsheet.

positions.title: Software Application Developer
positions.description:
Secretary of State IT Infrastructure	

- working on a various projects at a client location, Secretary of State (SOS), Indianapolis IN
- leading a project development of a multi-tier web application in .NET technology using MVC 4 and Entity Framework 5 concepts. 
- adopting Microsoft's Razor View Engine for developing rich user front end.
- using SQL Server Database 2008 for database back end.
- prepare work flow diagrams, and use cases for software development to define the project scope and functionality.
- Holding Weekly/Biweekly meetings with Business Users to provide progress of the project, and to collect changes to the    requirements. 
- prepare a test plan for a software application to perform unit testing. 
- before going into production environment, I develop a test environment for a software application to perform user acceptance testing.
- moving forward with the vision of developing a Mobile Application for the same project.

positions.title: Software Application Developer
positions.description:
- Managing a Project of a Reporting Web Application (Microsoft Reporting Services)
- part of a team which is developing a Licence Plate Recognition Software only solution. 
- following concepts of Object Oriented Programming to develop user friendly interface. 
- applying concepts of Multi-Threading to make front end available to user. 
- working with Client-Server architecture to provide centralized control to multiple clients. 
- using various third party tools to make application User Friendly.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description: I worked on a project called Network Management System. It is basically being developed using .NET Framework with c#. We have used web services, windows forms, and windows services. We have developed an SQL database for this system, which is placed on the SQL Server. This projetc is about to be completed. It's a first version of this kind of an Application. The company is planning for more future versions.
